l2_trend_policy.method: current canonical four-source composite minus the latest complete accepted canonical snapshot in the exact ISO weekly cycle two weeks earlier
l2_trend_policy.rank_method: ordinal rank by signed L2 change descending; team name is the deterministic tie-breaker

matrix_alert_policy.movement_generation_rule: latest refresh is very recent; two immediately preceding refresh generations are recent, subject to 90-minute expiry

selection_policy.latest_fast_pull_priority: Latest accepted fast quote pair always wins.
selection_policy.missing_pair_fallback: An exact missing or invalid fast pair may be filled only from the canonical current-market contract when the pair is complete, internally valid, and still satisfies the canonical quote-age limit at the fast-pull timestamp.
selection_policy.best_exchange_price_rule: Only an exchange quote priced -120 or better may compete for Best Exchange. Raw exchange quotes remain preserved.
selection_policy.best_sportsbook_price_rule: No -120 exchange filter is applied to the primary sportsbook group.
selection_policy.pinnacle_price_rule: Pinnacle is a separate sharp reference and is not subject to the Best Exchange filter.
selection_policy.pinnacle_matrix_display: Pinnacle remains canonical history and Activity context; the permanent matrix column displays the general opener.

model_policy.source: current_game_projection_contract.json strict resolved_projections plus explicit operational_projections
